name: @your-move/node
description: The Node runtime: HTTP server and static files (Docker target)

scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @your-move/web build && DATABASE_PATH="$(cd ../.. && pwd)/data/dev.sqlite" node --disallow-code-generation-from-strings --env-file=../../config/local-dev.env --import tsx src/main.ts --static ../web/dist --migrations ../../packages/server/migrations
